items.name: Meshy 7
items.why: 作為 Meshy 平台的新預設基礎模型,大幅提升圖像到 3D 模型的對齊度、紋理與風格保真度。
items.why_en: As the new default foundation model for the Meshy platform, it significantly improves image-to-3D model alignment, texture, and style fidelity.

items.name: Tripo 8K Texture
items.why: 推出原生 8K 紋理系統,為遊戲開發和數位內容創作提供更高解析度的生產級紋理。
items.why_en: Introduced a native 8K texture system, providing higher-resolution production-ready textures for game development and digital content creation.

items.name: Rodin Gen-2.5
items.why: 提供五種品質層級、高達 10M+ 多邊形生成、智慧低多邊形功能及 3D 原生紋理,強化生產級控制。
items.why_en: Offers five quality tiers, up to 10M+ polygon generation, Smart Low-Poly functionality, and 3D-native texturing, enhancing production-level control.

items.name: TRELLIS 2
items.why: 開源的 40 億參數模型,能從單一圖像快速生成高達 1536³ 的 PBR 紋理 3D 資產。
items.why_en: An open-source 4-billion-parameter model capable of rapidly generating up to 1536³ PBR textured 3D assets from a single image.
